subject: french
title: Human Rights and Equality
welcome_lead: Human rights and equality structure how we share the planet. Vocabulary of justice and inequality is essential.
meta_desc: French: human rights, equality, social justice.
final_note: Rights must be claimed in language — your French strengthens the claim.

walkthroughs.body_html: La Declaration universelle des droits de l'homme (1948), drafted in part by Rene Cassin. Cite it as foundation.
L'egalite des chances, l'egalite salariale. Useful: lutter contre les discriminations.
Use non seulement. mais aussi. for compound claims. Conclude with civic call: il appartient a chacun de.
